BUILT INTO THE SITE

Usability matters.

The site includes keyboard navigation, visible focus indicators, a skip-to-content link, labelled form controls, responsive layouts and reduced-motion support.

Software searches report the number of matching results. Forms use native validation and do not rely on colour alone to explain completion.

This is a development preview, not a claim of formal accessibility certification. A public feedback contact will be added when the business contact channels are established.
